flow.title: Our standard service flow
flow.lead: Six stages, from the first consultation to long-term maintenance.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: Clarify process node, capacity targets, site and facility limits, and define project scope.

steps.title: Evaluation and selection
steps.text: Compare tools across brands and propose workable options on specification, lead time and cost.

steps.title: Procurement and acceptance
steps.text: Execute commercial terms, then inspect condition and confirm documents before shipment.

steps.title: De-installation and shipping
steps.text: Standardized disassembly and protective packing, cross-border shipping and on-site acceptance.

steps.title: Installation and tuning
steps.text: Move-in positioning, reinstallation, utility hook-up, then functional and process tuning.

steps.title: Training and maintenance
steps.text: Operation and maintenance training, plus an ongoing servicing and support arrangement.
